data.notes: March 2026 in Courchevel leaned toward alpine spectacle and après-ski programming rather than standalone touring concerts, with the strongest confirmed music moments attached to resort festivals, Les Caves, and World Cup side-events.

events.title: Les Caves: Alex Wann
events.summary: Resident Advisor listed a late-night Les Caves De Courchevel club event on Sunday, March 1, 2026, running 23:00–05:00 with Alex Wann on the lineup.

events.title: International Festival of Pyrotechnic Art – Courchevel 1850 DJ & Fireworks
events.summary: Courchevel’s official calendar confirmed the March 3, 2026 Courchevel 1850 edition of the International Festival of Pyrotechnic Art, opening with DJ and entertainment before the torchlight descent and Fireworks Lieto display.

events.title: Gypsy Music Concert: Trio Czardas
events.summary: Courchevel’s official event page confirmed a free March 4, 2026 concert by Trio Czardas, featuring Russian gypsy folklore and Central European music with guitar, balalaika, violin, accordion and vocals.

events.title: International Festival of Pyrotechnic Art Awards & DJ Set
events.summary: Courchevel’s official calendar confirmed the March 5, 2026 awards ceremony for the International Festival of Pyrotechnic Art at Courchevel Moriond, followed by Show Time and a 7:30 pm DJ set.

events.title: Men’s Alpine Ski World Cup – Post-Race DJ & Concerts
events.venueName: L’Éclipse slope / Partners’ Village, Courchevel Le Praz
events.summary: Les 3 Vallées confirmed music programming alongside the March 13–15, 2026 Men’s Alpine Ski World Cup in Courchevel Le Praz: DJ Jo after Friday’s race, KTR6 on Saturday, and Bloc Off the Wall on Sunday.

events.title: Roc Merlet Derby Street Party – Concerts & Live DJ
events.venueName: Front de neige 1650 / Rue des Marquis
events.summary: Courchevel’s official calendar confirmed the March 29, 2026 Roc Merlet Derby, a long-running local ski event ending in Courchevel Moriond with a Derby Street Party, music stage, concerts and live DJ.
